```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between megapixels and price, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', hue='sensor_type', style='has_video_4k', palette='deep')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')
plt.title('Camera Price vs Megapixels by Sensor Type')
plt.legend(title='Sensor Type and 4K Video Capability')
plt.grid(True)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
